_about: How names and recurring terms are written in this language. Every translation follows this file, so a name is always spelled the same way. Names are written by sound, never translated (the author's rule). The spellings here are first versions based on the written names: the author's own pronunciation is recorded in Legacy/Behind The Scenes/World Lore/Word Pronunciation/Unique Words Pronounciation.wav, so correct any spelling here and later translations will follow it. Add new names the first time they are translated.
rule: Story names stay exactly as in English, as in Portuguese and Spanish. That includes coined world terms written as names: creatures, plants, items, nari gels, spells, factions, guilds, places, ranks and coins (Wood People, Sand Worms, Fost Stone, Nari Refresher, Red Winga, Sapphire, Pearl). Plain words around them are translated into Malay (nari gel stays, 'soul energy' becomes 'tenaga jiwa'), following Malay word order (Kerajaan Sanbi, Pengawal Forway). Exception: the currency balls is written bola (Malay has no plural marking; bola-bola only for emphasis); the rank follows it (bola Sapphire, bola Pearl). Faction names like Beer Balls stay as they are. Standard Malaysian Malay (Dewan Bahasa dan Pustaka spelling).
